findings.title: Existing output hardlink can overwrite protected input or external descriptor
findings.trigger: Run build_archive.py with --output tmp/hardlinked.zip when that path is an existing hardlink to paper.tex, paper.pdf, or publication/DEPOSIT_BINDING.json.
findings.observed: Source/PDF is overwritten before post-write failure; excluded descriptor is overwritten and command exits zero, in both normal and optimized modes.
findings.repair: Reject resolved aliases and existing samefile identities to all protected current inputs and external descriptor before writes, while permitting a separate ordinary archive output. Preserve old history and repeat a fresh whole review.
